exceptions.reason: Affects every node-forge release (1.4.0 is the latest) and no fixed release exists. node-forge reaches this image only through acme-client's legacy forge module (acme-client/src/crypto/forge.js); the broker calls acme.crypto only (src/acme-renewal.js createCsr, src/acme-account.js createPrivateKey), which uses Node's native crypto, so the affected RSA PKCS#1 v1.5 verification path is never executed.
